nonFunctionEffects.statement: begin;

create table public.weekly_contact_checking_scope_versions (
 scope_id uuid primary key references public.weekly_contact_pause_scopes(id) on delete restrict,
 revision bigint not null check(revision>=0),
 facts_sha256 bytea not null check(octet_length(facts_sha256)=32),
 facts_json jsonb not null check(jsonb_typeof(facts_json)='object'),
 recorded_at_utc timestamptz not null
);

create table public.weekly_contact_manual_reviews (
 id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
 request_id uuid not null unique,
 actor_user_id uuid not null references public.tms_users(id) on delete restrict,
 agency_id uuid not null,environment text not null check(environment in('TEST','LIVE')),
 audience text not null check(audience in('WORKER','MANAGER')),
 reason text not null check(char_length(btrim(reason)) between 1 and 1000),
 request_digest bytea not null check(octet_length(request_digest)=32),
 review_digest bytea not null check(octet_length(review_digest)=32),
 request_json jsonb not null check(jsonb_typeof(request_json)='object'),
 manifest_json jsonb not null check(jsonb_typeof(manifest_json)='object'),
 preview_json jsonb not null check(jsonb_typeof(preview_json)='object'),
 created_at_utc timestamptz not null,expires_at_utc timestamptz not null,
 check(expires_at_utc>created_at_utc)
);

create table public.weekly_contact_manual_acceptances (
 request_id uuid primary key references public.weekly_contact_manual_reviews(request_id) on delete restrict,
 review_id uuid not null unique references public.weekly_contact_manual_reviews(id) on delete restrict,
 actor_user_id uuid not null references public.tms_users(id) on delete restrict,
 request_digest bytea not null check(octet_length(request_digest)=32),
 receipt_json jsonb not null check(jsonb_typeof(receipt_json)='object'),
 accepted_at_utc timestamptz not null
);

create table public.weekly_contact_source_intent_captures (
 message_intent_id uuid primary key references public.weekly_message_intents(id) on delete restrict,
 capture_kind text not null check(capture_kind in('ROUTINE_RECOMPOSITION','EXPLICIT_MANUAL','ROUTINE_FOLLOWUP','ROUTINE_MANUAL_FOLLOWUP','MANUAL_RECOMPOSITION','FOLLOWUP_RECOMPOSITION','ROUTINE_MANUAL_SELECTION','MANUAL_SELECTION_RECOMPOSITION')),
 original_message_intent_id uuid references public.weekly_message_intents(id) on delete restrict,
 manual_request_id uuid references public.weekly_contact_manual_acceptances(request_id) on delete restrict deferrable initially deferred,
 accepted_actor_user_id uuid references public.tms_users(id) on delete restrict,
 agency_id uuid not null,environment text not null check(environment in('TEST','LIVE')),
 source_cycle_id uuid not null references public.weekly_source_cycles(id) on delete restrict,
 projection_publication_id uuid not null references public.weekly_source_projection_publications(id) on delete restrict,
 original_generation_membership_hash bytea not null check(octet_length(original_generation_membership_hash)=32),
 membership_hash bytea not null check(octet_length(membership_hash)=32),
 manifest_json jsonb not null check(jsonb_typeof(manifest_json)='object'),
 created_at_utc timestamptz not null,
 check((capture_kind in('EXPLICIT_MANUAL','MANUAL_RECOMPOSITION'))=(manual_request_id is not null)),
 check(capture_kind not in('EXPLICIT_MANUAL','MANUAL_RECOMPOSITION','ROUTINE_MANUAL_FOLLOWUP','ROUTINE_MANUAL_SELECTION','MANUAL_SELECTION_RECOMPOSITION') or accepted_actor_user_id is not null),
 check(capture_kind not in('ROUTINE_RECOMPOSITION','MANUAL_RECOMPOSITION','FOLLOWUP_RECOMPOSITION','MANUAL_SELECTION_RECOMPOSITION') or original_message_intent_id is not null),
 check(original_message_intent_id is distinct from message_intent_id)
);

create table public.weekly_contact_source_intent_capture_members (
 message_intent_id uuid not null references public.weekly_contact_source_intent_captures(message_intent_id) on delete restrict,
 logical_contact_key bytea not null check(octet_length(logical_contact_key)=32),
 budget_owner_key bytea not null check(octet_length(budget_owner_key)=32),
 native_member_kind text not null check(native_member_kind in('OUTREACH_MEMBER','SUBMISSION_MEMBER','MANAGER_MEMBER')),
 native_member_id uuid not null,
 selected_issue_ids uuid[] not null default '{}'::uuid[],
 candidate_id uuid not null references public.candidates(id) on delete restrict,
 client_id uuid not null references public.clients(id) on delete restrict,
 scope_id uuid not null references public.weekly_contact_pause_scopes(id) on delete restrict,
 scope_revision bigint not null check(scope_revision>=0),
 checking_revision bigint not null check(checking_revision>=0),
 audience text not null check(audience in('WORKER','MANAGER')),
 purpose text not null check(purpose in('CHECK_HOURS','SUBMIT_TIMESHEET')),
 incident_id uuid references public.weekly_discrepancy_incidents(id) on delete restrict,
 incident_episode integer check(incident_episode>=1),
 work_event_id uuid references public.weekly_work_events(id) on delete restrict,
 comparison_revision_id uuid references public.weekly_issue_comparison_revisions(id) on delete restrict,
 comparison_fingerprint bytea check(octet_length(comparison_fingerprint)=32),
 send_ordinal integer not null check(send_ordinal>=1),
 routine_step integer check(routine_step between 0 and 10),
 basis_accepted_membership_id uuid references public.weekly_contact_delivery_memberships(id) on delete restrict,
 native_basis_json jsonb not null check(jsonb_typeof(native_basis_json)='object'),
 primary key(message_intent_id,logical_contact_key,send_ordinal),
 unique(message_intent_id,native_member_kind,native_member_id),
 check(cardinality(selected_issue_ids)<=500),
 check((purpose='CHECK_HOURS')=(incident_id is not null and incident_episode is not null and work_event_id is not null
   and comparison_revision_id is not null and comparison_fingerprint is not null)),
 check(purpose<>'SUBMIT_TIMESHEET' or native_member_kind='SUBMISSION_MEMBER')
);
create index weekly_contact_source_capture_logical_idx on public.weekly_contact_source_intent_capture_members(logical_contact_key,send_ordinal);

create table public.weekly_contact_source_ordinal_owners (
 logical_contact_key bytea not null check(octet_length(logical_contact_key)=32),
 send_ordinal integer not null check(send_ordinal>=1),
 message_intent_id uuid not null references public.weekly_contact_source_intent_captures(message_intent_id) on delete restrict,
 revision bigint not null check(revision>=1),
 recorded_at_utc timestamptz not null,
 primary key(logical_contact_key,send_ordinal)
);

create table public.weekly_contact_recheck_progress (
 task_id uuid primary key references public.weekly_contact_recheck_tasks(id) on delete restrict,
 scope_revision bigint not null check(scope_revision>=0),
 checking_revision bigint not null check(checking_revision>=0),
 phase text not null check(phase in('SOURCE_ACTIVATION','SOURCE_WORKER','SOURCE_MANAGER','LEGACY_OUTBOX','COMPLETE')),
 last_native_id uuid,
 revision bigint not null check(revision>=1),
 recorded_at_utc timestamptz not null
);

create table public.weekly_contact_recheck_steps (
 id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
 task_id uuid not null references public.weekly_contact_recheck_tasks(id) on delete restrict,
 progress_revision bigint not null check(progress_revision>=1),
 phase text not null check(phase in('SOURCE_ACTIVATION','SOURCE_WORKER','SOURCE_MANAGER','LEGACY_OUTBOX','COMPLETE')),
 native_id uuid,
 scope_revision bigint not null check(scope_revision>=0),
 checking_revision bigint not null check(checking_revision>=0),
 facts_sha256 bytea not null check(octet_length(facts_sha256)=32),
 disposition_json jsonb not null check(jsonb_typeof(disposition_json)='object'),
 recorded_at_utc timestamptz not null,
 unique(task_id,progress_revision)
);

create table public.weekly_contact_source_due_event_rebases (
 original_event_id uuid not null references public.weekly_manager_cohort_due_events(id) on delete restrict,
 recipient_generation_id uuid not null references public.weekly_manager_recipient_generations(id) on delete restrict,
 rebased_event_id uuid not null unique references public.weekly_manager_cohort_due_events(id) on delete restrict,
 source_sha256 bytea not null check(octet_length(source_sha256)=32),
 source_json jsonb not null check(jsonb_typeof(source_json)='object'),
 recorded_at_utc timestamptz not null,
 primary key(original_event_id,recipient_generation_id)
);

begin;

do $prior$
begin
 if not exists(select 1 from pg_class relation join pg_namespace namespace on namespace.oid=relation.relnamespace
  join pg_attribute attribute on attribute.attrelid=relation.oid and attribute.attname='tranche_kind'
  join pg_constraint constraint_row on constraint_row.conrelid=relation.oid
   and constraint_row.conname='weekly_message_dispatch_commands_tranche_kind_check'
  where namespace.nspname='public' and relation.relname='weekly_message_dispatch_commands' and relation.relkind='r'
   and relation.relowner=(select oid from pg_roles where rolname=CURRENT_USER) and attribute.atttypid='text'::regtype
   and attribute.attnotnull and not attribute.attisdropped and constraint_row.contype='c' and constraint_row.convalidated
   and constraint_row.conkey=array[attribute.attnum]::smallint[]) then
  raise exception 'CONTACT_SOURCE_AUTOMATIC_TRANCHE_PRIOR_SCHEMA_MISMATCH' using errcode='55000';end if;
end;
$prior$;

alter table public.weekly_message_dispatch_commands add constraint weekly_contact_expected_original_tranche_ck
 check(tranche_kind in('CANDIDATE_INITIAL','CANDIDATE_REMINDER_6H','CANDIDATE_MANUAL_REMINDER',
 'TIMESHEET_SUBMISSION_INITIAL','TIMESHEET_SUBMISSION_REMINDER_6H','MANAGER_EARLY_ALL','MANAGER_T6_RESPONDED',
 'MANAGER_T12_REMAINDER','MANAGER_MANUAL_SELECTED','MANAGER_MANUAL_RESEND','COMPLETED_PACK_COPY')) not valid;
alter table public.weekly_message_dispatch_commands drop constraint weekly_contact_expected_original_tranche_ck;
alter table public.weekly_message_dispatch_commands drop constraint weekly_message_dispatch_commands_tranche_kind_check;

alter table public.weekly_message_dispatch_commands add constraint weekly_message_dispatch_commands_tranche_kind_check
 check(tranche_kind in('CANDIDATE_INITIAL','CANDIDATE_REMINDER_6H','CANDIDATE_MANUAL_REMINDER',
 'TIMESHEET_SUBMISSION_INITIAL','TIMESHEET_SUBMISSION_REMINDER_6H','MANAGER_EARLY_ALL','MANAGER_T6_RESPONDED',
 'MANAGER_T12_REMAINDER','MANAGER_MANUAL_SELECTED','MANAGER_MANUAL_RESEND','COMPLETED_PACK_COPY','MANAGER_AUTOMATIC_FOLLOWUP'));

do $generation_prior$
begin
 if not exists(select 1 from pg_class relation join pg_namespace namespace on namespace.oid=relation.relnamespace
  join pg_attribute attribute on attribute.attrelid=relation.oid and attribute.attname='trigger_kind'
  join pg_constraint constraint_row on constraint_row.conrelid=relation.oid
   and constraint_row.conname='weekly_manager_recipient_generations_trigger_kind_check'
  where namespace.nspname='public' and relation.relname='weekly_manager_recipient_generations' and relation.relkind='r'
   and relation.relowner=(select oid from pg_roles where rolname=CURRENT_USER) and attribute.atttypid='text'::regtype
   and attribute.attnotnull and not attribute.attisdropped and constraint_row.contype='c' and constraint_row.convalidated
   and constraint_row.conkey=array[attribute.attnum]::smallint[]) then
  raise exception 'CONTACT_SOURCE_COMPOSITION_PRIOR_SCHEMA_MISMATCH' using errcode='55000';end if;
end;
$generation_prior$;

alter table public.weekly_manager_recipient_generations add constraint weekly_contact_expected_original_generation_ck
 check(trigger_kind in('OFFICE_DIRECT','EARLY_ALL','T6_RESPONDED','T12_REMAINDER','NEW_INCIDENT','MANUAL_RESEND')) not valid;
alter table public.weekly_manager_recipient_generations drop constraint weekly_contact_expected_original_generation_ck;
alter table public.weekly_manager_recipient_generations drop constraint weekly_manager_recipient_generations_trigger_kind_check;

alter table public.weekly_manager_recipient_generations add constraint weekly_manager_recipient_generations_trigger_kind_check
 check(trigger_kind in('OFFICE_DIRECT','EARLY_ALL','T6_RESPONDED','T12_REMAINDER','NEW_INCIDENT','MANUAL_RESEND','CONTACT_COMPOSITION'));
